plan.authorized_change: One additional round with labeled cut-and-paste augmentation and false-caption-first threshold selection. Tests remain closed. Proceed to step 4 only if outer validation recall >=35% and literal false captions/min <=2.
plan.encoder: Same supplied YAMNet mono embeddings as round 2; same balanced logistic heads and C=0.1
plan.base_data: Both original and voice-reduced variants, with siblings in the same clip fold

augmentation.donors: Only human-labeled game-sound intervals from allowed training clips; extract from their aligned voice-reduced copies
augmentation.recipients: Other allowed training clips, randomly using original or cleaned backgrounds. A deterministic recipient assignment uses clip IDs only; if the recipient is excluded, the recipe is skipped before loading any waveform or cache.
augmentation.windows_per_mix: Up to three 0.975-second windows at different positions, plus identical background-only counterfactual windows with their own original labels
augmentation.labels: Retain recipient targets and shift/clip all overlapping donor game-sound labels, not just the selected event. No human CSV is modified.
augmentation.isolation: Every example records both donor and recipient IDs. Both must be inside that individual inner/outer training fold, including on cache hits. No mixing or training uses validation clips, their cleaned siblings, any test clip or Xonotic.
augmentation.limitation: These are copies of mixed gameplay snippets, not isolated studio effects; they can retain speech or other sounds. More synthetic examples are not new independent recordings.

plan.threshold_rule: Strict inner-validation false/min <=2 eligibility; among eligible thresholds maximize event recall, then fewer unmatched/min and higher threshold. 1.000001 is an explicit abstain-all candidate, guaranteeing feasibility without silently relaxing the false-caption constraint. Never select thresholds on the outer validation clip.
plan.evaluation: Same nested whole-clip leave-one-clip-out, original mixed outer audio, frozen round-0 caption scheduler and scorer, centered output hidden. Report literal false/min and broader unmatched/min. Inner feasibility does not guarantee outer performance.
plan.sealed_tests: Do not read media, labels, baseline prediction caches, or test scores. No final after test in this task.
